title: ubuntu-release-upgrader (1:26.04.22) resolute; urgency=medium
description: Resolute Racoon is an LTS, so the upgrade policy should reflect that.
commit_message:
ubuntu-release-upgrader (1:26.04.22) resolute; urgency=medium

  * data/release-upgrades: set Prompt=lts for resolute (LP: #2154602)

 -- Carlos Nihelton <email address hidden>  Fri, 29 May 2026 15:58:15 -0300
diff:
diff --git a/data/release-upgrades b/data/release-upgrades
index 5e740de..fd6dece 100644
--- a/data/release-upgrades
+++ b/data/release-upgrades
@@ -13,4 +13,4 @@
 #           the currently-running one.  Note that if this option is used and
 #           the currently-running release is not itself an LTS release the
 #           upgrader will assume prompt was meant to be normal.
-Prompt=normal
+Prompt=lts
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 3e7f8dc..7baa073 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+ubuntu-release-upgrader (1:26.04.22) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * data/release-upgrades: set Prompt=lts for resolute (LP: #2154602)
+
+ -- Carlos Nihelton <cnihelton@ubuntu.com>  Fri, 29 May 2026 15:58:15 -0300
+
